name: Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. engages in design, research, development, production, and marketing of photovoltaic cells in China and internationally. It engages in generation of N-type TOPCon solar cells. The company was formerly known as Hainan Drinda Automotive Trim Co., Ltd and changed its name to Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. in September 2022. Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is based in Haikou, China.
